ValidationRule.description: On Restraints Status having Applying Restraints / Error Applying Restraints in CAP, then Have All Defects Been Rectified cannot be changed to Yes.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = "KYC_QA", ISCHANGED( Fraud_Defects_Rectified__c ), ISPICKVAL ( Fraud_Defects_Rectified__c, "Yes" ), OR( ISPICKVAL ( Fraud_Restraint_Status__c , "Applying Restraints in CAP" ), ISPICKVAL ( Fraud_Restraint_Status__c , "Error Applying Restraints in CAP" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Incorrect Restraint Status, either automated restraints updates are in progress or failed. Please check the value before updating the Case.
